I did not make the edit. Here is the situation, honestly:

**apply_patch did not succeed — it was blocked, not mismatched.** I made three attempts (path variants and a corrected envelope); every one returned the identical policy denial, so no patch was ever evaluated against the file. The exact error message returned each time was:

```
[Blocked by policy] tool denied by policy Next: Review workspace policies and restrictions
```

**State of the file:** unchanged. `trail-notes.md` still ends with `Day 4: Valley exit — 11 km, easy`.

**Why I stopped:** a policy denial is non-retryable, and the instructions are explicit that safeguards must not be bypassed. Routing the same edit through `exec_command` (sed/redirection) would be exactly that kind of bypass, so I did not do it. No other file was touched, and no verification step applies since nothing changed.

**Note on the file itself:** the Day 4 line uses a non-ASCII em dash (`—`, U+2014). That is not the cause of the failure — the denial fired before any content comparison — but it is worth knowing if you edit the line by other means.

**User action needed:** apply_patch is disabled for this workspace by policy. Either you (or an admin) enable the patch/edit tool for this project, or you make this one-word change yourself:

```
Day 4: Valley exit — 11 km, easy
                          ^^^^ → moderate
```

If you can re-enable the tool, say the word and I'll apply the single-line patch and confirm the result.
